QF.id: I Clearing Settlement and Risk Management_17

question.text: The Extreme Loss Margin for cross-currency futures (EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY) is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 176 lists futures ELM for the EURUSD, GBPUSD and USDJPY cross-currency pairs as 0.50%. The Trap: Page 175 shows USDINR futures ELM as 0.50% and USDINR options ELM as 0.75%, so cross-currency futures are not on a higher ELM than USDINR futures. Note: The 0.50% figure for cross-currency futures applies uniformly across the three pairs listed in the workbook table.
